nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to tech without army; avoid neglecting scouting for early pressure.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing your tech and economy while strengthening your ground army. Increase production and technology, maintain defense, and consider expanding if safe.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about opponent's composition or if you face early pressure.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to N002 with heavier production and tech, still ground-oriented.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence suggests a ground posture with possible Marines. Production and economy appear heavy, technology heavy. Pressure is possible but not confirmed. Exact hidden counts are unknown.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground-oriented army with Zealots, moderate production, and heavy technology investment. Economy is heavy but expansion is uncertain. Defense is light, so you are vulnerable to early pressure.
nodes.strategic_reason: A heavy tech and economy investment pays off in the midgame if you survive early pressure. Maintaining a ground core keeps you flexible for tech switches.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech-Economy Foundation
nodes.transition_goal: Reach early-midgame with a stronger ground army, more production, and a solid economy.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game (~180s) with own ground-oriented posture, moderate production, heavy tech, and heavy economy. Opponent is likely ground-oriented with heavy production and economy, but exact composition is uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid engaging Siege Tanks without proper support; avoid neglecting detection or scouting for tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army, increase production and tech. Consider adding Sentries or Immortals to deal with tanks. Maintain defense and expand if possible.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you see a tech switch or if you are ready to push.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to N003 or N004 depending on whether you continue ground or tech into air.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marines. Production and tech are heavy, economy heavy. Pressure is possible, and Siege Tanks are a threat.
nodes.own_situation: You have a solid ground army with Zealots and Stalkers, heavy production and tech. Economy is heavy, expansion is uncertain. Defense is light, so you need to be careful against tank pushes.
nodes.strategic_reason: Siege Tanks require either Immortals or good engagements. Heavy tech allows you to tech into Colossus or other answers.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Tech Scaling
nodes.transition_goal: Reach midgame with a robust ground army and tech advantage.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early-midgame (~300-360s) with own heavy production and tech, ground army with Zealots and Stalkers. Opponent likely has Siege Tanks and Marines, heavy production and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; avoid neglecting air defense if opponent transitions to air.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain your ground army and continue increasing production and tech. Consider adding Colossus or High Templar for splash damage. Keep expanding and defending.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a decisive army advantage or if opponent tech switches.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to a late-game composition, possibly with air support.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground-heavy army with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, Hellions, and moderate air presence. Production and tech are heavy, defense heavy.
nodes.own_situation: You have a strong ground army with Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals. Production and tech are heavy, economy heavy, expansion heavy. Defense is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your ground army is strong, but you need to counter the opponent's composition. Splash damage helps against Marine-heavy armies.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army Consolidation
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a powerful late-midgame army that can take favorable engagements.
nodes.trigger_summary: Late-midgame (~600s) with own heavy ground army including Sentries and Immortals. Opponent has heavy ground with Siege Tanks, Marines, Reapers, Hellions, and moderate air presence.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being caught without splash against Marine-heavy armies; avoid neglecting scouting for tech switches.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army, increase production and tech. Consider adding Colossus or High Templar for bio. Maintain defense and expand.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have a tech advantage or if opponent shows air.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to N003 or a late-game composition.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence shows a ground posture with Marines and Marauders. Production and tech are heavy, economy heavy. Pressure is possible.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground army with Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals. Production and tech are heavy, economy heavy, expansion heavy. Defense is moderate.
nodes.strategic_reason: Immortals are strong against Marauders, but you need splash for Marines. Tech into Colossus or High Templar gives you that.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Tech with Immortal Core
nodes.transition_goal: Reach a strong midgame army that can push or defend effectively.
nodes.trigger_summary: Midgame (~540s) with own ground army including Immortals. Opponent has Marines and Marauders, heavy production and tech.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-expanding without army; avoid neglecting scouting for early aggression.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue developing tech and economy, but be careful with early pressure. Strengthen ground army and maintain defense while expanding.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have more information about opponent's intentions.
nodes.next_state_summary: Transition to N002 or similar with heavier production and tech.
nodes.opponent_situation: Enemy Intelligence is uncertain: possible ground posture with Marines, production moderate, tech heavy. Pressure unknown.
nodes.own_situation: You have a ground-oriented army with Zealots, moderate production, heavy tech, and moderate economy. Expansion is heavy, so you are investing in bases. Defense is light.
nodes.strategic_reason: Heavy expansion gives a long-term economy advantage, but you need to survive early. Tech investment will pay off later.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech-Economy with Expansion Focus
nodes.transition_goal: Reach early-midgame with a solid economy and tech foundation.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game (~180s) with own ground-oriented posture, moderate production, heavy tech, and moderate economy but heavy expansion. Opponent's posture is unknown but likely ground with Marines.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that emphasizes heavy technology and economy while keeping production moderate early, then scaling up. The strategic template is ground-leaning but retains flexibility to transition into air or mixed compositions based on live observations.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
